name: LongVPO-Stage2-InternVL3-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-06. A finetune of OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 7.944 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-02-04. Stage 2 of the LongVPO recipe; the repo also publishes Stage 1, already recorded separately as longvpo-stage1-internvl3-8b. Card column headers name the model 'LongVPO-InternVL3-7B' / 'LongVPO-InternVL3-8B' for the same 7.944B checkpoint; the repo id and base tag say InternVL3-8B. MVBench regresses 75.4 -> 75.0, recorded honestly as a loss.
